# A small unwrapped file is stored as a raw root, with no filename metadata.
env RAW_CID=bafkreih5nmdttx4kdmthclmf5ku2jaab7vfyih7rmauxjsvx3egz3phwhi
car create --no-wrap --file=raw.car file.txt
car root raw.car
stdout '^bafkreih5nmdttx4kdmthclmf5ku2jaab7vfyih7rmauxjsvx3egz3phwhi$'

# Extract to a directory using the root CID as the filename, even without verbose.
mkdir actual
car extract -f raw.car -o actual
stderr 'raw root .* is not wrapped in a UnixFS directory'
stderr '^extracted 1 file\(s\)$'
cmp actual/${RAW_CID} file.txt
! exists actual/unknown

# stdout contains only the raw bytes; the fallback warning stays on stderr.
car extract -f raw.car -o -
cmp stdout file.txt
stderr 'raw root .* is not wrapped in a UnixFS directory'
stderr '^extracted 1 file\(s\)$'

# CARv1 and the default output directory are supported too.
car create --no-wrap --version=1 --file=raw-v1.car file.txt
car extract -f raw-v1.car
cmp ${RAW_CID} file.txt
stderr '^extracted 1 file\(s\)$'

# CARv1 streaming input uses the same raw-root fallback.
mkdir actual-stdin
stdin raw-v1.car
car extract -f - -o actual-stdin
cmp actual-stdin/${RAW_CID} file.txt
stderr '^extracted 1 file\(s\)$'

# A raw root has no child paths. Do not extract unrelated data for a path request.
mkdir actual-path
! car extract -f raw.car -o actual-path missing.txt
stderr '^no files extracted$'
! exists actual-path/${RAW_CID}

-- file.txt --
raw file content
